title: Geodesic: a parallel test-particle geodesic tracker for the Einstein Toolkit (software)
description: Geodesic is an Einstein Toolkit thorn that integrates timelike test-particle geodesics through the spacetime carried on the Cactus grid. It samples the metric from the grid, integrates with GSL Runge-Kutta, and re-imposes g(u,u) = -1 after each step. It supports Carpet, CarpetRegrid2 AMR, MultiPatch grids, MPI + OpenMP, checkpoint restart, and basic CPU-only CarpetX support. Multi-rank behaviour with the grid samplers is validated at 1, 2 and 4 MPI ranks. The repository contains the thorn source, documentation and the parameter files of the published runs. New-thorn proposal: https://github.com/EinsteinToolkit/tickets/issues/2986 -- Scope of this record: the software only. The GPL-2.0-or-later licence covers the code, documentation and parameter files in this archive. The companion manuscript (Yuhua Li, 'Geodesic: a parallel test-particle geodesic tracker for the Einstein Toolkit', 2026, submitted to arXiv as gr-qc with astro-ph.HE cross-list) is a separate work under the author's retained copyright; it is not distributed in this archive and is not published through Zenodo.
